title: 并联电阻与分流公式
statement: 图示电路中，电流源 I_s = 6 A（方向向上），R_1 = 3 Ω，R_2 = 6 Ω 并联。
求并联电压 u_a，以及两支路电流 i_1、i_2（参考方向见图）。

questions.ask: 关于两个电阻并联时的分流，下列说法正确的是？
choices: 电阻大的支路分得的电流大
电流与电阻成反比，即与电导成正比
questions.explain: 并联支路电压相同，i_k = u / R_k = G_k·u，所以电流按电导成正比分配：电阻越小，电流越大。

hints: 并联电阻两端电压相同；两个电阻并联的等效电阻 R_{1}R_{2} / (R_1 + R_2)。
分流公式：i_1 = R_2 / (R_1 + R_2) × I_s——注意分子是“另一个”电阻。

en.title: Parallel resistors and the current divider
statement: In the circuit, the current source I_s = 6 A (pointing up) feeds R_1 = 3 Ω and R_2 = 6 Ω in parallel.
Find the parallel voltage u_a and the branch currents i_1, i_2 (reference directions as drawn).

questions.explain: Current-divider rule: i_1 = R_2 / (R_1 + R_2) × I_s = 6/9 × 6 = 4 A.

questions.ask: Which statement about two resistors sharing a current in parallel is true?
choices: The larger resistor takes the larger current
The current is inversely proportional to resistance, i.e. proportional to conductance
The two branch currents are always equal
questions.explain: Parallel branches have the same voltage, so i_k = u / R_k = G_k·u: the current divides in proportion to conductance — the smaller resistor takes more.

hints: Parallel resistors share the same voltage; two in parallel are equivalent to R_{1}R_{2} / (R_1 + R_2).
Current divider: i_1 = R_2 / (R_1 + R_2) × I_s — note the numerator is the *other* resistor.
solution: **1. Equivalent resistance.** R = R_1 ∥ R_2 = 3 × 6 / (3 + 6) = 2 Ω (or with conductances: G = 1/3 + 1/6 = 1/2 S).
**2. Parallel voltage.** u_a = I_s × R = 6 × 2 = **12 V**.
